c74object.name: evi.reson~
c74object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP reson~ as a TPT filter
c74object.description:
evi.reson~ is a 'max define' for the evi_reson.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.reson~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A linear TPT resonant bandpass filter. evi.reson~ has a very similar response as MSP reson~ and can therefore be used as a drop in replacement in most situations, but has better modulation characteristics with FM-able center frequency as well as optional auto gain compensation.

inlet.digest: Inlet #3: Center Frequency in Hz @min 1 @max samplerate*0.5
inlet.description: Center frequency of the resonant peak.
Filter resonance. Can be increasingly high values (e.g. 10000). See @compensate attribute for compensation.

attribute.name: compensate
attribute.description: Automatically compensate for the perceived reduction in gain (energy) when Q values are very high. Typically this should be on but is off by default to match MSP.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smooth the mixing gains of the filter efficiently at the core of the DSP. With these TPT SVF filters this will usually be the only smoothing required. By default smoothing is off.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.
